scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,bot "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run bot"
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build --prefix client && npx gh-pages -d client/dist -r https://github.com/pusucore/io-etkinlik.git
